name: Soap Making Business Spreadsheet
title: Soap Making Business Spreadsheet: Soap Cost Calculator, Recipe Costing, Batch Planner, Cure Tracker & Sales
etsy_title: Soap Making Spreadsheet, Soap Cost Calculator, Handmade Soap Pricing Template, Recipe Costing, Cure Tracker, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Know exactly what every bar of soap costs, what to charge for wholesale and retail, and when each batch is ready to sell.

WHAT YOU GET
• Recipe costing line by line, in oz, lb, g or kg
• % of oils for every oil and butter, automatically
• Cost per bar with packaging and labour, plus wholesale, retail and Etsy fees
• Batch planner: every ingredient to weigh out, with a stock check
• Cure tracker: ready dates and Curing / Ready status
• Dashboard: sales, profit, stock, best sellers, reorders

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings, Supplies & stock (100 rows), Recipes (300 ingredient lines), Soap Pricing (40 soaps), Batch Planner, Batches & Cure (200 batches), Sales log (500 rows).

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. This spreadsheet costs and prices your recipes; it does not calculate lye. Always use a trusted lye calculator and follow lye safety guidance.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.

name: Family Advent Activity Calendar
title: Family Advent Activity Calendar: 32 Activity Cards, Countdown Tree, Number Tags 1-25 & Paper Chain (Printable)
etsy_title: Advent Calendar Printable, Family Advent Activity Cards, Christmas Countdown for Kids, Number Tags 1-25, Paper Chain, Bucket List
description:
25 days of little family adventures: print, cut and fill your envelopes, bags or jar in one evening.

WHAT YOU GET
• 32 activity cards in 5 colour-coded themes: Make, Bake & treat, Cosy at home, Kindness and Out & about, plus 8 blank cards
• Countdown tree poster: colour one bauble every day from 1 to 25
• Number tags 1 to 25 (plus blanks) for envelopes, paper bags, boxes or a garland
• Paper chain countdown strips from 25 sleeps to 'Merry Christmas!'
• Grown-up advent planner, Christmas bucket list and an 'Our December Memories' keepsake page
• Mostly free or low-cost ideas; original, cheerful illustrations

INSIDE
Cover, How to use (4 set-up ideas + tips), Countdown tree poster, 5 sheets of activity cards, 2 sheets of number tags, 2 sheets of paper chain strips, Advent planner, Christmas bucket list, December memories page.

FILES
2 PDF files (15 pages each): US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Print at 100% / actual size, ideally on cardstock for the cards and tags.
3. Cut out the cards, tags and paper chain strips, fill your envelopes, bags or jar, and open one every day from 1 December.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For personal and family use (classroom use in your own class is fine too). Please don't share or resell the files.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.

name: Mid-Century Modern Wall Art, Set of 6
title: Mid-Century Modern Wall Art Set of 6: Terracotta, Mustard & Sage Abstract Prints (Printable)
etsy_title: Mid Century Modern Wall Art Set of 6, Printable Abstract Gallery Wall, Terracotta Sage Boho Prints, Geometric Art, Digital Download
description:
Six original mid-century abstract prints in warm terracotta, mustard and sage: a ready-made gallery wall that works all year round.

WHAT YOU GET
• Golden Hour: a sun over layered rainbow arches
• Bauhaus Blocks, Quarter Arcs and Balanced Stones: bold geometric shapes and soft organic forms
• Terracotta Hills (a sunset landscape) and Sage Botanical (a minimal leaf stem in an arch)
• 6 print ratios so they fit standard frames: 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 11x14, 5x7 and ISO A-sizes
• High resolution 300 dpi JPGs, up to 24x36 in (2:3) and A1 (ISO)
• Each design is composed for every ratio, not just cropped

INSIDE
Golden Hour, Bauhaus Blocks, Terracotta Hills, Sage Botanical, Quarter Arcs, Balanced Stones, Printing guide.

FILES
5 ZIP files of high-resolution JPGs (300 dpi): 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, ISO A-sizes, and 11x14 + 5x7 together (36 JPGs in all). Sizes: 2:3 (4x6, 8x12, 12x18, 16x24, 20x30, 24x36), 3:4 (6x8, 9x12, 12x16, 18x24), 4:5 (8x10, 16x20), 11x14, 5x7 / 10x14, ISO (A5, A4, A3, A2, A1). A printing guide is included.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Unzip the ratio that matches your frame and print at home, at a print shop or with an online photo lab.
3. Frame, hang and enjoy. Frames are not included.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For personal use only: print as many copies as you like for your own home or as a gift. Please don't share, sell or print the files for sale.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.
